explanation: OEIS A000108, Z.-W. Sun's comment: 'Conjecture: All the rational numbers Sum_{i=j..k} 1/a(i) with 0 < min{2,k} <= j <= k have pairwise distinct fractional parts' (since proved). The formal Catalan a(n) = C(2n,n)/(n+1) is exact, catalanReciprocalSum is Σ_{i=j}^k 1/a(i) in ℚ, and IndexCond (1 ≤ k, min 2 k ≤ j ≤ k) is the stated condition (0 < min{2,k} iff k ≥ 1). Injectivity of the fractional part over distinct admissible pairs (j, k) matches. Faithful.
